limitations: Higher tensor orders under one saved proposal test local quadrature only. They do not establish that this proposal resolves all separated modes or that the complete online sequence has converged.
numerical_node_effective_count_definitio: 1 / sum(normalized quadrature-importance mass squared); numerical concentration diagnostic, not a count of Monte Carlo samples.

7.omega_reference: Linearly interpolated recorded raw gyro for evaluation only; a noisy measurement, not angular-velocity truth
